acceptanceCriteria.description: The landing page loads without errors.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Open the page in a browser and verify no console errors.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The hero section displays a colorful gradient background.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Check that the hero section has a gradient background.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The CTA button opens a modal with a welcome message.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Click the CTA button and verify the modal appears.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The page is responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Resize the browser to different widths and verify layout adapts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All interactive elements have accessible names.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Use a screen reader to navigate and verify labels.
